# all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model attribution

This directory contains a quantized ONNX conversion of
`sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`, distributed as
`Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` at revision
`751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9`.

The model is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The full license text is
included in `LICENSE.txt`. Source and model-card information are available at:

- https://huggingface.co/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
- https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2

The model files are used only for local, in-browser feature extraction.
